image_description: A tall, wooden bookcase with five visible shelves filled with books and a few decorative objects. The bookcase has a light-to-medium wood finish with vertical side panels and horizontal shelf supports. The top shelf contains a small clock or decorative item among the books. The lighting appears natural, casting soft shadows within the shelves.

The object on the top shelf lacks clear structural definition; it appears slightly fused with the books behind it and has ambiguous geometry.
The vertical line of the right side panel shows slight waviness or inconsistency in straightness, suggesting minor geometric instability.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bookcase and not a similar shelving unit or cabinet.
To verify the 3D coherence of the shelves and ensure books are properly contained within the depth of the shelves without floating or clipping.
To check for boundary bleeding between individual books and the shelf surfaces, ensuring distinct object separation.
To assess the severity of text gibberish and texture anomalies noted in the initial scan.

focus_areas: Legibility and coherence of text on book spines
Geometric straightness of vertical and horizontal lines
Boundary separation between books and shelf surfaces
Structural plausibility of the decorative object on the top shelf
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the book spines. While some blurring is expected in low-resolution images, look for specific signs of AI-generated gibberish (e.g., impossible character shapes, melting letters). Also, verify if the perspective lines of the bookcase converge logically or if there are subtle warping artifacts in the wood grain.
